يجتذبون (form VIII)
# يَجْتَذِبُونَ (yajtaḏibūna) /jad͡ʒ.ta.ði.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
# يُجْتَذَبُونَ (yujtaḏabūna) /jud͡ʒ.ta.ða.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
